page.layout: Printed page 294 with a running head at top centre. Left margin: six italic marginal notes beside the central column. Centre: one column of consul names in eight groups of four, each group ruled off, with year numbers (1503 to 1510) and a second number column (1511 to 1517) on the right. Right margin: partly cut-off notes at the edge. Bottom right: catchword "Herman".

p.note: Iudicijs prorogatis sæpius, varijs colloquijs tentata cōpositio.
Compositio tentata per Philippum Austriacum Burgundiæ ducem.
Groninga armis Saxonicis duce Edfardo obsessa, & in angustias redacta.
Groninga in fidē Edfardi concedit, exclusis Saxonibus.
Cognitio controversiæ inter Saxonum & Groningatios instituta Constantiæ, cognitoribus a Maximiliano Cæs. Ordinibus Germaniæ datis.
Edfardus novare quædam in rep. Groning. molitus fuit.

page.notes: The year numbers are placed beside the second line of each group, as their position suggests. Their exact alignment with the names could not be confirmed. The right margin notes are cut off at the scan edge; their visible fragments are "transflat[?]", "gestum.", "captum.", "latus:" and "Piepus [?]", and the rest is not legible. The marks (†, ‡, *) beside 1513 to 1517 are copied as they appear. The word "Constantiæ" in the left note is uncertain. The name "Herman Lewe" in the 1507 group is printed as "Heiman Lewe" in the scan; this is a printing irregularity and is left as "Herman" for consistency with other groups, with the scan's form noted here.
